column1: # Verb table v2: which cognitive process (revised Bloom taxonomy) a verb is read as.
#   level    remember | understand | apply | analyze | evaluate | create   (C1 .. C6)
#   process  the Anderson-Krathwohl cognitive process the verb is read as, when one fits
#   also     other levels where published verb lists or the framework itself place the verb
#   basis    AK    the name of a process in Anderson & Krathwohl (2001), or one of its listed alternative names
#            LIST  commonly placed on this level in published lists of measurable verbs
#            DEV   the developer's reading of a software-work verb the framework does not list
#            ID    Indonesian equivalent of an English row (the developer's translation)
#            SOFT  interpersonal verb: the cognitive dimension fits it poorly; never used for a hard skill
#            DEFAULT  supplied by the method when the postings give no verb; never sets a level
# See SOURCES.md in this folder. UNREVIEWED: no expert has checked this table.
